'''Hunter Billy''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{Zone|Critter Safari}}. They allow the player to obtain a random [[Attribute Shard]] in exchange for a specified item.

== Purpose ==
'''Hunter Billy''' sells a random [[Attribute Shard]] per {{Zone|Critter Safari}} instance with a random cost.

| {{Item|Yogi Berry}}, {{Item|Orange Gem}}, {{Item|Bag of Seeds}}, {{Item|Purple Gem}}, Wriggleworm
|}
